product_metadata.title: Japanese Noren Ukiyoe The Great Wave off Kanagawa Door Way Curtain 59"x33.45"
features: MATERIAL: 100% closely woven cotton. Thick, tight-woven, accordion, high quality, not the soft cotton but a bit hard special for Japanese noren curtain
Dimensions: 59”(L) by 33.5”(W). It can be used as window curtain, door curtain, door way curtain, room divider, wall tapestry. NOTE: confirm the dimension before making purchase
Degree of Translucency: Light hardly pass through
Style: Traditional and original Japanese noren curtain, pre-separated. One sided woodblock printed Ukiyoe - The Great Wave off Kanagawa
How to Clean: saline soak for fixation. Use neutral detergent in hand/machine wash, do not use detergent that contains whitener or bleach. Warm iron
description: Thick Natural Cotton Japanese Noren Curtain for Doorway/Door - The Great Wave off Kanagawa, 59" x 33.45"
Usage: door curtain, window curtain, doorway curtain, room divider, wall tapestry

Woodblock printing is a technique for printing text, images or patterns originating in China. Ukiyoe is the best known type of Japanese woodblock art print. Most European uses of the technique for printing images on paper are covered by the art term woodcut.
